reason: Primarily discretionary trading of OTC/penny stock breakouts, overextensions and panic dips using tape/level-2 with no concrete numeric rules; heavy shorting component.
method_name: Penny stock breakout and dip trading

universe.description: OTC and low-priced NASDAQ penny stocks with high volume and clean price action

setup.rule: high volume and clean daily candles (full body, no wicks)
setup.quote: the number one thing for me is volume ... my number two indicator is I'm looking at technical levels ... nice full body candle

setup.rule: buy breakouts after spike and pullback on scams
setup.quote: buying breakouts in a strong Market SO waiting for a stock to spike waiting for it to pull back and then waiting to buy a breakout. I like doing it on scams

exits.rule: scale size with P/L; exit on loss of momentum or liquidity issues
exits.quote: if I'm making money I'm using more size if I'm losing I'm using smaller size

sizing.rule: max ~$150k position; smaller on illiquid names
sizing.quote: I really don't want to size in more than like a hundred fifty thousand dollars into it

market_filter.rule: prefer strong speculative market; avoid bear markets for OTC
market_filter.quote: if stocks like apple and Tesla ... aren't even going to hold ... these BS penny stocks have zero chance

ambiguities.issue: mentions daily candles but relies on intraday tape/level-2 for execution
shorting described but engine is long-only
